must_include: The response thanks or directly acknowledges the reviewer and states what was checked and changed.
The authoritative estimate is −0.06 standard deviations with a 95% confidence interval of −0.10 to −0.02.
The obsolete −0.09 value is identified as the source of the conflict and removed.
Causal and welfare claims are explicitly withdrawn or downgraded.
The synchronization checklist covers Table 4, abstract or introduction, results text, and conclusion.
must_avoid: Claiming that a cross-sectional estimate proves causality.
Claiming any welfare improvement without a benchmark and incidence analysis.
Invented page numbers, exhibits, analyses, or citations.
human_review: The response is candid, non-defensive, and auditable.
The replacement sentence can be pasted into a manuscript without meta-commentary.
The checklist prevents the corrected value from remaining inconsistent elsewhere.
